title: Scenic Half Marathon Rayong 2026 Review: Thailand's Coastal Park 21K
seo_title: Scenic Half Marathon Rayong 2026 Review | RSMH Thailand Race
meta_description: The Scenic Half Marathon Rayong (RSMH) 2026: August 2 at Laem Charoen Public Park. 21K, 10K, 5K from Scenic Marathon Series — registration open.
dek: Set for 2 August 2026 at Laem Charoen Public Park in Rayong, this Scenic Marathon Series event offers three distances with registration open. A Gulf-of-Thailand coastal park half marathon.
verdict: The Scenic Half Marathon Rayong (RSMH) brings the Scenic Marathon Series to Thailand's eastern seaboard — Laem Charoen Public Park, a coastal green space in Rayong overlooking the Gulf of Thailand. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) with registration open. August in Rayong is the rainy season — expect warm, humid conditions but a flat coastal course. Part of the same series that includes Chiang Mai, Krabi, and Nakhon Phanom, so the production template is proven. A solid Gulf-coast Thai half marathon with open registration.

sections.heading: Rayong's Coastal Park
paragraphs: Laem Charoen Public Park is a waterfront green space on Rayong's coast, providing a flat, scenic course with Gulf-of-Thailand views. [1] The Scenic Marathon Series' production template — proven at Chiang Mai, Krabi, and Nakhon Phanom — ensures a well-run event. August is rainy season: expect warm, humid conditions.
